summary.intent: Fix two bugs in `entire explain --generate`: (1) Codex sessions producing 'transcript has no content to summarize', and (2) Claude CLI subprocess hanging/canceling with an opaque double-wrapped error message.
summary.outcome: Codex support for `explain --generate` was fully implemented, reviewed, lint-fixed, and pushed to PR #875 on branch `codex-explain-generate`. The Claude-side timeout/cancellation issue was diagnosed but deferred to a follow-up.

repo: The `summarize.BuildCondensedTranscriptFromBytes` switch handles Gemini, Droid, OpenCode, Claude/Cursor but was missing `AgentTypeCodex`, causing silent empty-transcript fallback.

Codex raw transcripts are rollout event streams (`session_meta`, `response_item`, `event_msg`) — structurally incompatible with the Claude/Cursor JSONL parser that expects `user`/`assistant` lines with a `message` payload.
Existing Codex normalization logic already existed in `transcript/compact/codex.go` but was never wired into the `--generate` / summarization path.
`CheckpointTranscriptStart` stores a raw JSONL line offset, not a response-item count — an easy semantic mismatch when writing Codex-specific scoping helpers.
Scoped Codex checkpoint transcripts start at `response_item` (after `session_meta` is sliced off), so format detection in `compact/codex.go` needed to accept that suffix as valid Codex.
`ClaudeGenerator` shells out to the user's local `claude` binary via `exec.CommandContext`; Entire does not call Anthropic's API directly for summary generation.
The double-wrapped error `failed to generate summary: failed to generate summary: ...` comes from independent wrapping in both `summarize.go` and `explain.go`.
The same Codex summarization gap exists in the auto-summarization path during condensation (`strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go`), not just in `explain --generate`.

code.finding: Agent-type switch for transcript parsing omits AgentTypeCodex, causing fallback to Claude/Cursor parser which produces empty output for Codex rollout JSONL.
Empty condensed transcript triggers 'transcript has no content to summarize' error — this is the exact error seen for Codex sessions.
Default generator is ClaudeGenerator; error from it gets wrapped here, contributing to double-wrapped error message.
Calls summarizer and wraps error a second time, producing the double 'failed to generate summary' prefix seen in Claude cancellation case.
ClaudeGenerator runs `claude --print` via exec.CommandContext with no timeout wrapper; can block indefinitely and produces exit -1 on Ctrl-C.
Existing Codex normalization logic; reused in the fix rather than creating a parallel parser. Format detection also needed widening to accept scoped (post-session_meta) Codex suffixes.
Same Codex AgentType omission exists in auto-summarization during condensation — Codex summaries broken in both the explicit --generate path and the automatic condensation path.

workflow: Worktree sandbox blocked direct branch creation on the parent repo `.git`; required escalation or alternate approach.
Red-green-refactor: failing tests were written first to confirm the broken state before implementing the fix.
Go build cache restrictions in the sandbox required escalation flags on `go test` invocations.
Bugbot and Copilot PR review caught a real semantic bug (offset unit mismatch), not just style issues — worth reviewing bot comments before pushing follow-ups.
CI lint (`golangci-lint` with `goconst`) flagged a repeated string literal that was easily fixed by introducing a named constant.
Local binary built to `/tmp/entire-codex-explain-fix` for manual end-to-end verification by the user against real checkpoints before committing.

friction: Worktree sandbox blocked branch creation, requiring a workaround.
Go build cache restrictions in the sandbox forced escalation flags on every `go test` run.
First Codex implementation attempt used wrong offset semantics (response-item count vs. raw line offset), requiring a follow-up fix after PR review.
Double-wrapped error message (`failed to generate summary: failed to generate summary: ...`) made the Claude-side failure harder to diagnose from user output alone.
No progress indicator during `explain --generate` — a hung Claude subprocess gives the user no feedback before they Ctrl-C.
open_items: Claude-side `--generate` issue: add timeout around ClaudeGenerator subprocess, detect context.Canceled/DeadlineExceeded explicitly, and collapse the double-wrapped error message into a single clean error.
Fix the same Codex AgentType omission in `strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go` so auto-summarization during condensation also works for Codex sessions.
Droid agent scoping in `explain` is less explicit than Gemini/OpenCode — noted as a potential follow-up to standardize.
PR #875 still needs CI to pass after the follow-up commit before it can be merged.
